documents.title: Public debt
documents.content:
# Public debt

Public debt sustainability depends on the interest-growth differential, the primary balance, and the maturity structure. A country can stabilize its debt ratio when nominal growth offsets financing costs.

Code: DEBT-SUST-2024. Acronym: IGD (interest-growth differential).

documents.title: Emergency fund
documents.content:
# Emergency fund

Keep six months of essential expenses in liquid, low-risk accounts. Refill the emergency fund before increasing speculative investments.

Target amount code: EF-6M-LIQUID.

documents.title: Project Alpha
documents.content:
# Project Alpha

The launch decision is September 15. The team chose a small private beta before public access, with Alice responsible for onboarding.

Related: [[Alice]] [[Second Brain product]]
Ticket: ALPHA-LAUNCH-0915.

documents.title: Alpha postmortem
documents.content:
# Alpha postmortem

After launch, onboarding drop-off was 40% at the second screen. Alice proposed a single-step welcome flow. Decision owner: Alice. Linked project: [[Project Alpha]].

documents.title: Second Brain product
documents.content:
# Second Brain

The product should keep Obsidian as the source of truth. Assistant answers become personal knowledge only after explicit user review and vault write.

Stack acronym: ORAG (Obsidian Retrieval Augmented Graph).

documents.title: Product rename history
documents.content:
# Product rename history

2024-01: codename Nightjar.
2024-06: renamed to Second Brain for user testing.
2025-01: brand Sillage adopted publicly while vault paths stay Second Brain.

documents.title: Sleep routine
documents.content:
# Sleep routine

Stop caffeine after 2 PM, dim screens one hour before bed, and keep the bedroom cool. The target is eight hours with a consistent wake time.

documents.title: Running plan
documents.content:
# Running plan

Run three times per week: one easy session, one interval session, and one long slow run. Increase weekly distance by no more than ten percent.

documents.title: Nutrition preference v1
documents.content:
# Nutrition preference (2023)

Prefer high-protein breakfasts and intermittent fasting 16:8. Avoid dairy on weekdays. Valid until superseded in 2024.

documents.title: Nutrition preference v2
documents.content:
# Nutrition preference (2024)

Current preference: three regular meals, no intermittent fasting. Dairy is fine. This supersedes the 2023 nutrition preference.

documents.title: Reading list
documents.content:
# Reading list

The library includes Thinking in Systems by Donella Meadows, The Beginning of Infinity by David Deutsch, and The Design of Everyday Things by Don Norman.

documents.title: Writing preferences
documents.content:
# Writing preferences

Prefer concise prose, concrete examples, and short paragraphs. Avoid inflated introductions and excessive headings.

documents.title: Language preferences
documents.content:
# Language preferences

Répondre en français par défaut. Utiliser un ton direct et concret. Acronyme interne: FR-DEFAULT-TONE.

documents.title: Database decision
documents.content:
# Database decision

PostgreSQL is the application source of truth. Neo4j stores graph relations and pgvector stores derived document chunks.

documents.title: Database decision (superseded)
documents.content:
# Database decision (2023, superseded)

Originally chose MongoDB for flexibility. This decision was replaced by PostgreSQL in 2024. Do not treat MongoDB as current.

documents.title: Riga trip
documents.content:
# Riga trip

Visit the Central Market on Saturday morning and book the Art Nouveau district walk for Sunday. The preferred hotel area is the quiet centre.

documents.title: Lisbon trip
documents.content:
# Lisbon trip

Fly into LIS on 2025-03-12. Stay in Alfama. Must-try: pastéis de Belém. Booking code: LIS-ALF-0312.

documents.title: Alice
documents.content:
# Alice

Alice leads customer onboarding for Project Alpha. She prefers asynchronous design reviews on Tuesday afternoons.

Email demo: alice.onboarding@example.test

documents.title: Bob
documents.content:
# Bob

Bob owns infrastructure for Project Alpha. He prefers synchronous standups on Monday mornings and tracks uptime with code UPTIME-SLA-99.

documents.title: RAG notes
documents.content:
# Retrieval augmented generation

Hybrid retrieval combines lexical search, vector similarity, graph facts, reciprocal rank fusion, and reranking. Citations must retain stable chunk provenance.

documents.title: BM25 notes
documents.content:
# BM25 notes

BM25 ranks documents by term frequency with length normalization and inverse document frequency. Exact title matches should outrank weak body matches.

documents.title: Roadmap meeting 2024-11-01
documents.content:
# Roadmap meeting 2024-11-01

Decision: delay public launch of Project Alpha to mid-September. Alice tracks onboarding metrics. Bob owns reliability gates.

documents.title: Brand meeting 2025-01-10
documents.content:
# Brand meeting 2025-01-10

Decision: public brand is Sillage. Internal vault name remains Second Brain. Marketing code: BRAND-SILLAGE-2025.

documents.title: Debt ratio myth
documents.content:
# Debt ratio myth

Some blogs claim debt sustainability only depends on absolute debt size. This note is intentionally wrong relative to the real public-debt note. Ignore absolute size as the sole driver.

documents.title: Alpha fake date
documents.content:
# Alpha fake date

Rumors say Project Alpha launches on December 1. This is incorrect evaluation bait. The real launch decision remains September 15 in the official Alpha note.

documents.title: Sleep rumor
documents.content:
# Sleep rumor

A viral post claims the target is five hours of sleep with late caffeine. This contradicts the real sleep routine note and must not be retrieved as truth.

documents.title: Wikilink hub
documents.content:
# Wikilink hub

Index of related notes: [[Project Alpha]], [[Alice]], [[Database decision]], [[RAG notes]], [[Riga trip]]. Tags: #evaluation #hub.

documents.title: Acronym glossary
documents.content:
# Acronym glossary

ORAG: Obsidian Retrieval Augmented Graph.
IGD: interest-growth differential.
RRF: reciprocal rank fusion.
HNSW: hierarchical navigable small world.

documents.content:
